headline: IMF-World Bank meetings begin in Bangkok, a turning point in the face of current geopolitical challenges
summary: The annual IMF and World Bank meetings in Bangkok focus on artificial intelligence, support for small businesses and economic resilience. Africa's growth prospects also feature on the agenda.
why: The IMF and World Bank provide lending and policy guidance to governments, and their annual meetings shape the global economic outlook.
